The default mode Network or dmn is a cognitive science concept research shows that there's a particular part of your brain that becomes active when you're not busy thinking about anything in particular. This is also known as wakeful rest. This area tends to have the same thoughts over and over. These are the thoughts you Circle back to when you're not thinking about anything. Mendel Kalin suggests. We think of the mind like a hill covered in fresh snow. Each thought is a sled that slides down that Hill leaving a trail. The more sleds that slide down those same Trails the deeper those Trails become and the more difficult it becomes to avoid sliding into the same repetitive thought patterns. Alpha Traders, hold 2 contradictory skills at once they can sit there and do nothing for long periods, and they can act aggressively without hesitation. Listen to your default thoughts when your mind is quiet and determine if they are beneficial or toxic for what it's worth, this is a useful exercise to run outside of trading too. Do the default voices in your head criticize or motivate you? Do they spur you toward action or convince you to procrastinate? I believe that navigating the cacophony of competing voices in your head and choosing which ones to or and which ones to listen to is 1 of the most important determinants of survival and success in both trading and in life shutting out the toxic voices and following the beneficial ones is the definition of conscientiousness willpower and discipline.
